messages:
sarah: Quick follow-up from the partial-response postmortem — we need clear owners and timelines for the streaming/chat reliability fixes. summary: timeouts, partial responses, reconnect/backoff, observability gaps.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-10 closed (root cause: connection flaps + aggressive timeouts).

jake: I can own the reconnect/backoff piece (A1). Plan: prototype exponential backoff + jitter and safe reconnect markers.

priya: I'll take A2 (timeout tuning + classification for partial-response). Add histograms for response chunk gaps.

marta: A3 for alerts and dashboards. I will add an SLO alert for >0.5% partial responses over 5m and a dashboard for per-region streaming gaps.

connor: Do we want automatic fallback to non-streaming (batch) for long reconnects? who owns the routing policy?

jake: Good call. I'll add a routing policy change as part of A1: fallback to chunked polling after N failed reconnects (configurable).

priya: Required metrics: chunk_interval_ms (p50/p95), last_chunk_timestamp, reconnect_attempts. I'll add tags for region, model_variant, client-sdk.

sarah: Draft timelines: A1 (jake) prototype by 2026-03-26, PR for initial rollout by 2026-04-02. A2 (priya) metrics + classification by 2026-03-30. A3 (marta) alerts + dashboard by 2026-03-28. A4 (team) run 1-month recurrence analysis by 2026-04-10.

marta: putting tasks in the incidents board now. linking postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-10

jake: quick config sketch for backoff (will iterate):
```
reconnect: {
  max_attempts: 6,
  base_delay_ms: 200,
  max_delay_ms: 5000,
  jitter: 0.25,
  fallback_threshold: 3 // after 3 failed reconnects switch to polling
}
```

priya: I also propose adding a "partial_response" tag on the RPC path so logs/metrics can correlate with upstream LBs and infra events.

connor: Who owns the customer-facing retries? Do we change SDKs too?

sarah: SDK changes are needed but lower priority. A5: SDK retry guidance (owner: eng-devex) — I'll loop in alex from devex. target: docs + example by 2026-04-15.

jake: For rollout: canary on Dedicated then Redwood Hosted. I'll add a canary toggle and automatic rollback if partial_response rate increases > 0.2% vs baseline.

marta: note on recurring pattern: spikes are EMEA mornings and after large model updates. A4 to include correlation with deployments and region traffic.

priya: I'll add synthetic tests that stream a long response and intentionally drop packets to measure recovery window.

sarah: Good. Owning list recap: A1 reconnect/backoff + routing fallback — jake. A2 timeout tuning + metrics/classification — priya. A3 alerts + dashboard — marta. A4 recurrence analysis — sarah + analytics. A5 SDK guidance — eng-devex (alex).

connor: Please add estimated engineering hours to each ticket so we can prioritize with PM.

marta: Will do. I'll create the tickets and add owners/estimates by EOD.

sarah: Thanks all. We'll do a 30m follow-up sync Thursday to confirm PR plan and canary gating. @jake @priya @marta please prepare short status updates. :thumbsup:
